title: Why Can't We Go Home? Military Occupation of Land in Sri Lanka
scope: Post-war land occupation, commercial military activity and government disengagement commitments
limitations: Human-rights investigation with a rights-based framing; site evidence is detailed but not a neutral government inventory.

title: Country policy and information note: Tamil separatism, Sri Lanka
scope: Security conditions and checkpoint reporting, including explicit note that reinstatement report could not be independently corroborated
limitations: Government country-note synthesis; checkpoint item traces to Tamil Guardian and explicitly reports no corroborating source found.

title: Land Released to Civilians in Jaffna — District Secretariat ceremony
author_or_institution: Security Forces Headquarters — Jaffna, Sri Lanka Army
scope: Official record of 40.70 acres released in three plots on 1 May 2025
limitations: Official self-reporting; useful for occurrence/area released, not for evaluating overall demilitarisation performance.

title: Valikamam North residents continue protests demanding release of military-held lands
scope: Local protest reporting on continued military land occupation and commercial/agricultural use
limitations: Tamil-nationalist editorial position; strong local event documentation but not independent corroboration of aggregate troop/land claims.

title: Faire une randonnée dans les Hortons Plains au Sri Lanka
scope: Visitor logistics only: loop length, duration, direction and mist timing
limitations: Personal travel account. No historical or ecological claim may rest on it.

title: Central Highlands of Sri Lanka — World Heritage property
scope: Horton Plains as a component of the Central Highlands serial property; montane forests, endemic biodiversity and management framework
limitations: World Heritage conservation assessment; does not establish colonial causal genealogy or resolve World's End cliff-height conventions.

title: Horton Plains
scope: Plateau hydrology and headwaters of Mahaweli, Walawe and Kelani rivers
limitations: Tourism authority rather than park management plan; adequate as an institutional lead for hydrology, not for proving colonial conservation motives.

title: Commemorative stone inscription, Ambasthala, Mihintale — military contributors to Mihindu Seya restoration
author_or_institution: Mihintale Rajamaha Viharaya; Department of Archaeology; named donor and military contributors
author_institution: Mihintale Rajamaha Viharaya / Department of Archaeology
scope: Cross-corpus comparator evidence: named armed-forces contribution to a Buddhist restoration project in 2024
limitations: Primary evidence for the named 2024 contribution only; not evidence of generalized reception in Sinhala-majority areas.
